assessments.reasoning: Authenticity follows from publisher_live at Creative Commons' zero/1.0/legalcode.txt endpoint. Integrity follows from its matching [5884,6024) digest and its whole-body digest matching publisher_pin and the claim scope. Relevance follows from 4(a) naming both trademark and patent rights. Interpretation follows from its paired exclusions of rights being “waived” or “licensed” and its concluding “otherwise affected by this document”. Applicability follows from “held by Affirmer” and the Statement of Purpose identifying the person applying CC0 to the Work. The contradiction check finds that sections 2 and 3 each address the Affirmer's Copyright and Related Rights, 1(iv) preserves the 4(a) limitation, and 4(c) separately addresses rights of others.

limitations: This finding concerns the instrument's stated effect on rights held by the Affirmer. Separate grants, defenses, ownership and third-party clearances require separate evidence.
reasoning: When an Affirmer applies CC0 to a Work, section 4(a) expressly preserves trademark and patent rights held by that Affirmer. Its wording covers both surrender under the waiver and licensing under the fallback.
